title: Fixed-base square portal frame with a uniform load on the beam

source.work: Bentley Systems, STAAD.Pro Help, Verification Examples (public documentation, docs.bentley.com)
source.edition: STAAD.Pro Help v21 build (pages refer to the STAAD.Pro 2023 sample files), read 2026-11-22
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text and input listing). The page cites: McCormac, Structural Analysis, 3rd ed. 1975, p. 383, example 22-5 - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'theory' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Plane problem in the global X-Y plane (Y vertical); the out-of-plane DOFs (uz, rx, ry) of every node are held; in-plane bending about local z. Portal 20 ft x 20 ft, fixed bases, all members A = 1 ft^2, I = 0.05 ft^4, E = 4.132e6 kip/ft^2 (the page's listing); 2 kip/ft downward on the beam. Units kip, ft. First-order analysis with axial deformation. The page's 'maximum moment' (44.40 kip ft) is the largest member END moment, at the beam-column joints; the midspan moment of the beam is larger (55.6 kip ft, also a target here). Reference values: computed here from this statement (verification/derive/vendor_reference.py); the textbook cited by the vendor page was not opened and no number is taken from it.
